basis_note: computed and simulated values only; no hardware exists and nothing was measured

qspi.electrical_length_note: longest net 23.5 mm = 0.14 ns; a 1 ns edge is 7 times longer, so the nets are lumped

bootsel.isolation: R106 1 k between QSPI_SS and the 39 mm BOOT_BUTTON net: tau = 1 k x 5.3 pF = 5 ns, load on /CS is 1 k in series
bootsel.esd_note: IEC 61000-4-2 source is 330 ohm / 150 pF; through R106 the peak current is V / 1.33 k. 2 kV gives 1.5 A, about the 1.33 A of the 2 kV HBM rating (RP2350 Table 1681). The pad is not protected beyond that.

swd.limit: RP2350 Table 1687: SWCLK 10 MHz typ, 50 MHz max. 67 mm = 0.4 ns one way, 2.5 % of a 16 ns half period at 30 MHz.

run.note: RUN has only the internal pull-up, no capacitor, an exposed 1 mm test pad (TP6) and 87 mm of track. The datasheet states no glitch filter, so none is assumed.

switch_off_or_board_unpowered.back_power_path: none: the switch isolates with Ioff, and U13 has clamp diodes to GND only (no supply pin)
switch_off_or_board_unpowered.load_on_external_driver_pF: about 12-13 (5 pF switch + 0.47 pF U13 + 6-7.5 pF track)

switch_on.pass_voltage_note: SN74CB3T3245 Figure 8-3 (VCC 3.0 V, 1 uA): output 2.8 V for inputs 2-3.9 V, 3.15 V for inputs above 4.5 V; Figure 5-2 (25 C, VI 5.5 V, 100 uA): 3.15-3.2 V at VCC 3.3 V. Scaled to VCC 3.3 V below.
switch_on.mcu_drives_out: 3.3 V through 1 k + about 5 ohm; a 5 V CMOS input (VIH 3.5 V) is not met, 5 V TTL (2.0 V) is
switch_on.adc_pins: GPIO26/27 are standard (not fault-tolerant) pads, abs. max IOVDD + 0.5 V: the switch keeps them below 3.45 V x 39/40

expansion.pull_downs: R140-R145 39 k: with stepping A2 erratum RP2350-E9 needs 8.2 k or less; on A4 (required by the BOM) 39 k holds a floating line at 0 V (1 uA leakage -> 39 mV)
expansion.enable: U11 /OE is driven by U12 TLV810E (active-high reset, 2.93 V) with R128 100 k to +3V3: the switch is off below 2.93 V and on whenever the rail is up; firmware cannot turn it off
